LESSON: COMMON

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: LISTENING
Topic 2.1: Common

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Common. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Respond appropriately to general • In pairs

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Respond appropriately to general • In pairs
   In simple words: practise until you can respond appropriately to general • In pairs. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Common using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Common in the examples.
2. Explain Common to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Common.
4. Show that you can: Respond appropriately to general • In pairs

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Common using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Common important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

4. Listen to and watch clips of people greeting and bidding farewell recorded in devices and practise responding to greetings and bidding farewell.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Respond appropriately to general • In pairs
